hook_text: A potato, a mealie and a banana walk into a market. What do they have in common?
clip_script: Warwick Junction, Durban. Potatoes, sweet potatoes, mealies, beans, bananas. Every one is a plant's food store! Plants make glucose, then change the extra into starch to keep for later. A potato is a stem. A sweet potato is a root. Maize is a seed. Now the test: one drop of brown iodine on a potato slice. Blue-black! Starch is there.
visual_style: Whiteboard market stall with each food labelled by plant part, then a drop of iodine turning blue-black on a potato slice.
mood: Lively and busy, like a market morning.
pacing: Quick tour of the stall, one surprise about the potato, then the colour test.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and sort the vegetables in your kitchen by plant part.
